title.value: Discovering Object-Centric Generalized Value Functions From Pixels
title.justification: The title explicitly states the focus of the paper, which is on discovering object-centric generalized value functions from pixel data.
title.quote: Discovering Object-Centric Generalized Value Functions From Pixels

extractions.description: The paper introduces a method to automatically discover object-centric generalized value functions (GVFs) from pixel data in reinforcement learning. This method, termed as OC-GVFs, focuses on using slot attention mechanisms and meta-gradient approaches to discover meaningful features from objects, which are then used for learning control policies. The primary aim is to improve control and adaptation in both stationary and non-stationary environments by utilizing these learned GVFs as features.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: The central theme of the paper is developing reinforcement learning techniques for improved feature discovery and control through generalized value functions. There is no direct mention or focus on climate or ecological sustainable development objectives or applications.
sustainable_development_is_central.quote: Learning control from high-dimensional input such as images is a complex problem relevant to many real world applications. While researchers have made huge strides in Deep Reinforcement Learning (RL), decision making from images remains a challenge due to the difficulty of discovering meaningful features that are invariant across tasks.

primary_category.justification: The paper focuses on reinforcement learning and feature discovery for control tasks in machine learning environments, without any explicit connection to climate or ecological sustainable development.
primary_category.quote: We propose OC-GVFs: an end-to-end approach to automatically discover object-centric General Value Functions from pixels. Our method can subsequently be used as features for learning the downstream control policy.

secondary_categories.justification: There are no secondary themes in the paper related to any climate or ecological sustainable development goals.
secondary_categories.quote: Learning control from high-dimensional input such as images is a complex problem relevant to many real world applications.

secondary_sub_categories.quote: To evaluate the agent’s ability to quickly adapt to novel situations, we introduce the agent to new unseen levels in the CoinRun and StarPilot domains over time without any prior task information.

new_primary_category.quote: Designing meaningful auxiliary tasks poses many challenges; most previous works considered them in order to learn visual features entirely without rewards.
